title: Anthropic's FlashProve proves which model answered — at 70x the cost
summary: A wide rundown, from Google tying school search to its AI tools to Postman's uninvited agent plugins, Ai2's StateBench and England's PlanAssist. Then three short dives: Anthropic's FlashProve prototype for proving which model produced an answer, Revolut's self-hosted coding bill, and a guest essay on Terence Tao's blog about egoless mathematics.

topics: Anthropic's FlashProve provable-inference prototype: a weight commitment plus a per-response zero-knowledge proof; Llama 4 Maverick at about 110 proof tokens/s on one H100, ~19 MB proofs, ~17 s CPU verification, ~70-95x overhead vs vLLM; limits (1,024-token context, greedy integer decoding, MoE only, fast code unverified); no deployment plans; contrasted with the Claude text watermark extension

Revolut's switch to self-hosted GLM-5.3 on 56 B200s for AI coding: ~90% cost cut, ~$0.30 per million tokens, gains from NVFP4, disaggregated prefill/decode and context tuning; 'Long context is a scam'; unrationed tokens shifting work to debugging and tickets; quality and hardware amortization not disclosed
Egoless Mathematics in the AI Era (Karthik C. S., Sahai, Xue, guest on Tao's blog): Platonism, metrics vs worth, refusing the human-taste refuge; Alan's career-incentive objection left open

threads.name: AI-generated mathematics and verification
threads.status: A guest essay on Terence Tao's blog argues the AI-proof anxiety exposes a pre-existing habit of tying mathematicians' worth to output and credit; no policy proposal
threads.arc: From labs claiming results on foundational conjectures to mathematicians arguing about what credit was ever for

dives.why_it_matters: API buyers, evaluators and regulators currently cannot verify which model served a response; this is the first open prototype fast enough to make that checkable on a 400B model, with its 70-95x overhead the number to track.

Engineering leaders weighing Claude Code or Codex seats against open weights get a rare public bill from a 2,000-engineer company, with the tuning that produced it and the gaps (quality, hardware cost) it leaves open.

dives.story: Egoless mathematics in the AI era
dives.why_it_matters: Mathematicians and anyone following AI-for-science credit fights get a clear statement of the case that AI-found proofs threaten standing, not truth, at a moment when labs are claiming results on major conjectures.
